title: The outer column
summary: The column along the right edge: six keys, all for the little finger.
intro: Your right little finger carries more keys than any other, and the ones on the edge are the ones almost nobody practises. They sit further from the home row than anything else, so the trick is the usual one: out, press, back, without the hand following.
congrats: That column is the one most courses leave half-done. Not yours.
